title: The Rare Perfumes
description: A modern and fully functional e-commerce perfume store with product management, shopping cart, and secure checkout experience.
author: Muhammad Shakeeb Raza
longDescription: Designed and developed a complete e-commerce solution for a perfume brand. The platform includes a dynamic product catalog, advanced product filtering, shopping cart functionality, and a smooth checkout process. Implemented an admin panel for product management, order handling, and content updates. Focused on responsive design, performance optimization, and user-friendly UI to ensure a seamless shopping experience across all devices.

title: LangkawiBook Motor
description: A business-focused vehicle booking and tourism platform designed to simplify rentals and customer interactions.
author: Muhammad Shakeeb Raza
longDescription: Developed a comprehensive business website for vehicle rentals and tourism services. The system allows users to explore vehicles, search and filter options, and view attractions with detailed information. Built using Laravel with a strong backend structure and a responsive frontend. Emphasis was placed on usability, clean design, and performance to support both local and international users.

title: GAREEB NAWAAZ SURGICAL LTD
description: A corporate website built to represent a surgical manufacturing company with structured product and category management.
author: Muhammad Shakeeb Raza
longDescription: Created a professional business website for a surgical instruments company. The project includes category-based product listings, dynamic content management, and Google Sheet integration for easy data handling. Focused on simplicity, clarity, and maintainability while ensuring the platform effectively represents the brand and its product offerings.

title: Pikachudeals
description: A coupon and deals platform designed to showcase discounts, offers, and promotional content.
author: Muhammad Shakeeb Raza
longDescription: Developed a coupon-based website that allows users to browse deals, offers, and categories with ease. Implemented a clean UI, dynamic content loading, and category-based filtering. The platform is optimized for performance and usability, making it easy for users to find relevant discounts while providing a scalable backend for future growth.

title: Autoboli
description: A high-performance live digital vehicle bidding and auction marketplace built with real-time data streaming architectures.
author: Muhammad Shakeeb Raza
technologies: Vue.js, PHP, Laravel, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, Socket.io, Redis, MySQL, Docker, AWS (EC2), Nginx, Python Selenium
longDescription: Autoboli is a premium, real-time automobile auction system engineered to handle concurrent high-velocity bidding loops. The core engine is built using Laravel and Vue.js, featuring real-time state synchronization via Socket.io and Redis memory layers to achieve sub-millisecond data updates during active biddings. Deployed in containerized Docker microservices on AWS, the architecture incorporates smart search modules, advanced multi-parameter vehicle filters, a secure multi-tier financial checkout terminal, and a comprehensive admin monitoring matrix for dynamic live inventory operations.

title: POS Management
description: A high-velocity Point of Sale and inventory ledger engine engineered for real-time retail transaction tracking and retail analytics.
author: Owais Azam
technologies: PHP, Laravel, JavaScript (ES6+), jQuery, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3, Dynamic PDF Generation Engines
longDescription: A robust commercial-grade Point of Sale (POS) and Enterprise Resource Planning framework designed to scale retail operations. Built using Laravel's robust MVC architecture, the platform orchestrates complex inventory tracking modules, multi-vendor procurement pipelines, and dynamic real-time financial ledger calculation matrices. Features a streamlined frontend for rapid transaction checkouts, responsive data grids for auditing, automated PDF invoice generation loops, and localized secure terminal sessions tailored to maximize data processing speed and minimize database deadlock latencies during concurrent checkout flows.

title: Gym Fitness Center
category: Fitness SaaS & Club Management Management Engine
description: A tailored member operations platform and operational engine designed for fitness tracking, membership workflows, and automated subscription management.
author: Kreatix Solutions
technologies: PHP, MySQL, JavaScript (ES6+), jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, Responsive Layout Frameworks
longDescription: A premium enterprise-level Fitness & Gym Operations Platform built to orchestrate end-to-end client conversion pipelines and membership workflows. Engineered using a structured PHP backend architecture coupled with a highly responsive frontend matrix, the system flawlessly handles dynamic membership tiered subscriptions, digital client intake operations, class schedules, and automated operational logging. The interface is optimized to deliver ultra-fast content delivery, clean data tracking for gym admins, and a seamless client experience designed to maximize member retention and simplify day-to-day fitness facility automation.

title: Imedia Software Solutions
description: A high-performance corporate agency web ecosystem designed to showcase enterprise software consulting capabilities and digital solutions architecture.
author: Imedia Software Solutions
technologies: PHP, MySQL, JavaScript (ES6+), jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, Core SEO Optimization Frameworks
longDescription: A premium enterprise-level corporate web ecosystem built to display end-to-end IT consulting pipelines and custom digital product architectures. Engineered using a highly modular PHP architecture and optimized for ultra-fast load times, the platform delivers clean data presentation for diverse software development pipelines, service listings, and integrated enterprise client acquisition forms. The frontend features smooth layouts, responsive interface mechanics, and strict cross-device accessibility matrices designed to establish maximum corporate authority and seamless user conversions.

title: SmartDentalInnovations
description: A premium medical-grade digital ecosystem engineered to showcase innovative dental technologies, specialized clinical products, and laboratory solutions.
author: Imedia Software Solutions
technologies: PHP, MySQL, JavaScript (ES6+), jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, Advanced Data Grid Filtration, Core SEO Architectures
longDescription: SmartDentalInnovations is a cutting-edge healthcare informatics and product presentation ecosystem built to streamline dental asset discovery and corporate clinical outreach. Developed using a highly optimized and secure PHP architecture, the platform features a multi-tiered diagnostic and product catalog matrix with advanced multi-parameter filtering grids. The system is engineered for sub-second page performance, featuring secure client intake funnels, cross-device clinical compliance rendering, and search engine optimization frameworks designed to anchor maximum authority in the global biomedical and dental tech marketplace.
